change_summary: Changed b_block_ptr order from (0, 1) to (1, 0) so Triton lays the [BLOCK_K, BLOCK_N] B-tile in shared memory with N as the contiguous dimension, matching how tl.dot reads across N for each K-step and eliminating 5.3-way shared memory bank conflicts.
